skill.compatibility: Requires ffmpeg and (for downloads) yt-dlp on PATH; Python 3.9+ with dghs-imgutils (anime person detection + CCIP). The CCIP step runs on CPU — do NOT set ONNX_MODE=CoreML (CCIP crashes there); person detection is fine on CoreML. Anime / 2.5D-render art only — not for live-action. Optional --clean (subtitle/watermark removal) needs rapidocr-onnxruntime + simple-lama-inpainting.
skill.description: Extract and organize frames from a Bilibili video (bangumi episode, UP upload, or a local file) into scenery shots and per-character image groups, using anime-specific person detection + CCIP character-identity embeddings. Two modes — cluster everyone, or pull out one (or several) named characters via reference folders. Use when the user wants to collect, extract, or organize anime frames/screenshots by character or by scenery from a Bilibili video. Read-only download for personal viewing/analysis; uploads nothing.
